citations.assessment: The Bavli gives Rabbi Eliezer spending Shabbat in the sukkah of Yochanan be-Rabbi Ilai. It gives Qesari and Qesaryon as variants. Its name formula does not assign sage status to the host.

holds.reason: The Bavli preserves a patronymic form and recounts the stay. Keep Heilprin’s expressed uncertainty about the man’s status.
The received Caesarea and the cited Bavli’s Qesaryon are preserved in their respective witnesses. The place identification awaits collation.

notes.text: The Bavli confirms the Sabbath stay and records a different patronymic and place-name form. Preserve the head entry’s forms and the narrator’s uncertainty.
